title: Storm Related Closure Updates
summary: Several 1st Source Banking Centers located in LaPorte, Porter, and St. Joseph Counties were affected by recent storms, and some locations are closed due
body_markdown:
Several 1st Source Banking Centers located in LaPorte, Porter, and St. Joseph Counties were affected by recent storms, and some locations are closed due to storm-related issues.


Before heading out to your nearby banking center, check out the status of the location below.


**Banking Centers currently closed due to weather-related issues:**


*Updated Wednesday, August 12 at 1:00pm EST*


- [Chesterton – Closed](https://www.1stsource.com/locations/chesterton-banking-center/)
- [Kouts – Closed](https://www.1stsource.com/locations/kouts-banking-center/)
- [LaPorte Boyd – Closed](https://www.1stsource.com/locations/laporte-boyd-banking-center/)
- [LaPorte West – Closed](https://www.1stsource.com/locations/laporte-west-banking-center/)
- [North Liberty – Closed](https://www.1stsource.com/locations/north-liberty-banking-center/)
- [Portage Central – Closed](https://www.1stsource.com/locations/portage-central-banking-center/)
- [Valpo Circle – Closed](https://www.1stsource.com/locations/valparaiso-circle-banking-center/)
- [Valpo Downtown – Closed](https://www.1stsource.com/locations/valparaiso-downtown-banking-center/)
- [Valpo West – Closed](https://www.1stsource.com/locations/valparaiso-west-banking-center/)
- [Westville – Closed](https://www.1stsource.com/locations/westville-banking-center/)
- [Willowcreek – Closed](https://www.1stsource.com/locations/willowcreek-banking-center/)


Nearby locations that are open:[Michigan City](https://www.1stsource.com/locations/michigan-city-marquette-banking-center/) ,[Hebron](https://www.1stsource.com/locations/hebron-banking-center/) ,[Lacrosse](https://www.1stsource.com/locations/lacrosse-banking-center/) .[Valpo North](https://www.1stsource.com/locations/valparaiso-north-banking-center/) ,[Walkerton](https://www.1stsource.com/locations/walkerton-banking-center/) .


While some of our physical locations are closed, we still have teams that are ready to help with your banking needs:


- Our Customer Service Team is available and can be reached by calling574-235-2000 or800-513-2360 , from 8:30 AM – 6:00 PM ET weekdays and 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM ET on Saturday.
- To find a nearby location, visit one of our other 78[banking center locations](https://www.1stsource.com/locations/) .
- As always, our[online and mobile banking](https://www.1stsource.com/login/) is available to clients 24/7.
